title: Finite evaluation of the normalized projective-line splitting
statement: Let l be prime, let X and S be Noetherian schemes with the derived localization choices of [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], f:X→S, and p a Presentation for E=Q_l in the sense of [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation]. Assume l is invertible on S. For each n≥0, evaluation at level n+1 sends the actual specified unit/Chern map p.model.bq to an isomorphism. The finite coefficient ring is the level n+1 quotient, the section class is the positive Kummer class of the pullback of O(1), and no assertion about twisting components or a system trace is part of the conclusion.

source.place: paragraph (1), components of the twisted unit/chern splitting

proof.text: Apply the cohomological criterion for isomorphisms to the actual evaluated biproduct-desc map. Exact evaluation preserves cohomology vanishing. The coefficient unit is a degree-zero single object, so its evaluated H² vanishes. The inverse Tate line is also a degree-zero single object, so its shift by minus two has evaluated cohomology zero in every degree other than two.

In degree two apply the finite Chern-component theorem with p.finiteX. In every other degree apply the finite coefficient-unit theorem with p.model.model, over_eq and coefficientPullback. For an additive functor F, when F(V) is zero, F(inl):F(U)→F(U⊞V) is an isomorphism: F(fst) is its inverse by the biproduct total identity. Thus invertibility of F(a) implies invertibility of F(desc(a,b)); use the symmetric argument when F(U) is zero. These are the two proved private categorical helpers in the delivered module. This proves invertibility in every degree, hence the required derived isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1); U2 cohomology assembly of the separate unit and Chern components of (G2)

theorem diagonalTrace_finite_splitting
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((SpTowerShriek.Ev l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S n).map
      (p.model.bq l (ULift.{u} (Padic l))))
